Torrential potential held me close
Before I rose to let it boast -
What actually is goes before it knows.
So, revolve around the sun.
Come once again Forever says
To see me through the eternal round
This up and down is heaven’s zest.
Our prisms pry the cosmic sound
So live and ply, weave as you breathe
The moments heritage from the roots to the leaves
And sing forth the coming days
As flighted dawn becomes your melodious displays
Where matutinal red sits grounding,
Gently rising hues expounding.
